echoParts: 'You shall love the Lord your God
This is the great and first commandment.
verseText: And he said to him, 'You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind. This is the great and first commandment.'
meaning: Out of all the commandments in the Bible, there is one that is most important of all: to love God with all that we are and all that we have, more than anything else in the world.
